note: COPIED INTO THE REPORT BUNDLE at phase 5 from charts/before/ (re-copied byte-for-byte at the second phase-5 pass, md5-verified against charts/before/) so the archive is self-contained (the `file` paths are rewritten to report/before/; the schema shape is unchanged - decision D5 forbids a schema change, not a path correction). The as-is baseline captured before any code change, scoped to the paths the fix touches. flow.mmd is sighting 1 (a plan offered before it is written); sequence.mmd is sighting 2 (an item being built sits in the plan column and escapes the cap).
